answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to post a refundable work bond before it may transact: the bond sits like a juniper hedge around a willow grove, cheap to plant yet costly to uproot at scale. New identities start with zero trust and earn standing only through verified, useful work over time, so spinning up a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand bonds and doing a thousand honest jobs first. Anyone caught running sock-puppets forfeits the bond and the identity, turning the fable of free fake influence into a ledger of real, priced losses.
